snippet.title: Big Adventure: Trip to Europe 2 Game Trailer
snippet.description:
AvexGames presents the second game in the Big Adventure: Trip to Europe series! This is a completely new trip with new locations to visit and hidden objects to find! Plus, complete a variety of exciting mini-games. The journey will take you through diverse locations spread across 30 amazing tourist spots.

Download the Free Trial for PC!

Available Now!
